dispatch_policy.maximum_parallelism: one plan-review gate, then independent file-scope fan-out

reused_external_tasks.reason: Already owns the durable Agora handoff to policy-learning readback and ACK path and declares the whole services/control-plane/bff/agora parent scope; new BFF tasks wait for it instead of duplicating it.
Already owns processed policy candidate handoff into the existing Research experiment authority.
Already owns submitted-only special intake and the real Consultation workflow/provider path; no duplicate Consultation implementation task is created.

tasks.title: Review and merge the Agora product GAP and SD baseline
tasks.reviewer_capability: scope, dependency, and materialization evidence review
acceptance: Independently review the exact PR #4834 head referenced by the signed bridge packet and verify the GAP findings against representative frontend and backend source evidence.
Validate all execution task IDs are unique, the DAG is acyclic, frontend and backend scopes remain in their own repositories, and declared parent/child path overlaps are ordered.
Confirm L12-MFC-R4-AGORA-001, L12-MFC-R4-IMITATION-001, and L12-MFC-R4-CONSULT-001 are reused rather than duplicated and record their canonical state at review time.
Publish an independent review-proof tag for the exact head, require all PR checks to pass, merge PR #4834 to dev, and record the merge SHA.
Do not implement any product gap or dispatch a repair from findings during this plan-review task.
tasks.rollout: Documentation and execution-catalog merge only; its completion releases independent implementation tasks.
tasks.rollback: Revert the documentation merge; leave product, runtime, and canonical task rows unchanged.

tasks.title: Replace Persona-first Workshop with durable strategy reconstruction
tasks.owner_capability: backend workflow, privacy, and durable worker implementation
out_of_scope: Persona service redesign outside Agora intake
acceptance: Workshop create/message persists a scoped command, receipt, private payload reference, and reconstruction outbox before returning; HTTP 202 performs no provider work inline.

A leased worker produces a validated StrategyReconstructionResult with the twelve strategy blocks, explicit/inferred/assumption/conflict sets, evidence, server-derived completeness, and exactly one next-best question.
Remove or fail-close the public completeness writer, synthetic unbound identities, permissive readiness fallback, and same-key conflict-only idempotency.
Create or adopt an immutable Registry draft through authenticated service context and canonical readback while keeping StrategySpec truth out of Workshop storage.
Prove same-key replay, stale-result supersession, worker crash recovery, BFF/worker restart readback, private-content redaction, and two-user/two-tenant isolation.
tasks.rollout: Ship behind the existing Workshop capability in read-only-safe dev; activate reconstruction only after worker readiness is healthy.
tasks.rollback: Disable reconstruction and keep Workshop history readable; never restore client-written completeness or synthetic readiness.

tasks.title: Scope Research and generate candidates only from real lineage
tasks.owner_capability: research orchestration, API security, and lineage persistence
tasks.reviewer_capability: tenant isolation and research-artifact truth review
acceptance: Every Research/candidate mutation requires write authority, owner lookup, idempotent receipt semantics, CAS where state is mutable, and audit.
Plans, runs, stages, artifacts, discussions, pools, and member actions persist tenant/user scope and foreign IDs return non-enumerating not-found responses.
Replace facade-only dispatch with durable outbox/lease/backend job adoption and ordered progress/artifact projection with explicit real, simulation, fixture, or unavailable provenance.
Remove _default_registry_candidates from production behavior; empty authoritative input returns an empty pool with exclusion reasons.
Expose owner-scoped strategy/version-to-current-pool lookup and prove backend-create crash recovery, duplicate delivery, restart readback, and cross-tenant denial.
validation: Postgres restart and artifact checksum readback
tasks.rollout: Enable adapters individually; unavailable adapters return explicit empty/degraded state.
tasks.rollback: Disable dispatch/pool generation without restoring hard-coded candidates or unscoped access.

tasks.title: Correct Trading Room authority, identity, compiler, and transactions
tasks.owner_capability: backend domain, authorization, and transaction design
acceptance: All Trading Room writes require write role, owner scope, request-hash idempotent replay, CAS, audit, and canonical readback; decision events, intents, handoffs, and SSE are tenant/user scoped.
Workspace proposal accepts typed user intent and strategy/version identity only; server resolves readiness, evidence, freshness, and candidate pool from authoritative owners.
Rename/extract deterministic generation as WorkspaceCompiler and reject client readiness/freshness truth, local agent claims, unavailable required sources, and synthetic identity.
Workspace snapshot, immutable version, current pointer, event, receipt, and outbox commit atomically; failure injection leaves no partial version state.
Missing position/risk sources project unavailable or degraded, never empty-position plus normal-risk success; approval creates a no-order TradingIntent only.
tasks.rollout: Keep workspace writes capability-gated until authoritative readiness and scoped data readback pass.
tasks.rollback: Return Trading Room to scoped read-only mode; do not restore caller-provided readiness or normal-risk defaults.

tasks.title: Add live widget data adapters and a real decision-event producer
acceptance: Implement an allowlisted query contract whose every widget response carries status, source, as_of, cutoff, lineage, data, and explicit unavailable reason.
Implement only sources with authoritative adapters; unwired widget types remain unavailable and cannot enter the live registry.
Project owner-scoped signal/risk/runtime evidence into decision events containing probability, EV, risk, invalidation, freshness, and evidence references.
Missing or stale risk/data fails closed and no adapter substitutes sample rows, default metrics, or normal status.
Prove adapter tenant isolation, point-in-time cutoffs, producer idempotency, restart recovery, and absence of any broker/order authority.
tasks.rollout: Register each source only after its readiness/freshness contract passes; keep the producer no-order and feature-gated.
tasks.rollback: Unregister the affected source/projector and expose unavailable state while preserving durable events.

tasks.title: Build owner-scoped Strategy Performance and suggestion production
tasks.owner_capability: telemetry projection and governed action production
acceptance: Add an Agora-owned StrategyPerformanceIndex scoped by tenant/user/strategy/version and separate observed, simulated, shadow, stale, and unavailable facts.
Remove the need for Agora clients to consume the global Management performance-attribution projection.
Add a governed producer that upserts suggestions from named evidence/policy/model versions with cutoff, lineage, expiry, proposed change, and safety rationale.
Reuse existing suggestion CAS, action receipt, audit, and restart-safe store; apply creates a Workshop/Registry proposal and never silently mutates runtime.
Prove zero seeded suggestions are required, cross-tenant access is denied, source lag is visible, and action state survives restart.
tasks.rollout: Enable the index read-only first, then enable governed suggestion actions after producer lineage is accepted.
tasks.rollback: Disable suggestion production/actions while retaining owner-scoped performance reads and audit history.

tasks.title: Separate dataset acceptance from extraction and delivery workers
tasks.owner_capability: durable outbox, privacy, and worker recovery
tasks.reviewer_capability: data eligibility and delivery ordering review
acceptance: Interaction-evidence API returns only after atomically persisting eligible evidence, inbox/outbox, receipt, and scope; it does not invoke process_inbox or wait for worker completion.
A separately leased worker validates consent/purpose/retention/redaction, creates immutable DatasetVersion, and publishes the existing durable handoff path.
ACK remains ordered after durable policy-learning admission/readback from L12-MFC-R4-AGORA-001; failures retry with backoff and DLQ without bulk-acking historical rows.
Raw private conversation remains excluded without explicit consent and minimization; logs/traces/audit contain no private payload.
Prove crash recovery before/after dataset creation and delivery, duplicate replay, tenant isolation, and restart readback.
tasks.rollout: Start workers with existing pending rows preserved and bounded rate; monitor age, retry, ACK, and DLQ metrics.
tasks.rollback: Pause workers with outbox rows intact; never acknowledge undelivered data or broaden retention.

tasks.title: Make policy handoff admit-only and worker-leased
tasks.reviewer_capability: fail-closed runtime and lease recovery review
acceptance: Agora handoff endpoint validates scope and lineage, durably creates/adopts a proposed candidate, and acknowledges admission without claiming or processing it inline.
Remove process_immediately from production semantics; scheduler/worker alone leases, renews, processes, recovers, and terminally records candidates.
Product mode reads only tenant-scoped DatasetVersion authority and never substitutes seed data when authority is missing or degraded.
Behavior-cloning/evaluation output stores checksum, metrics, limitations, dataset lineage, and explicit runtime_effect=none.
Prove duplicate admission, worker crash/lease expiry/recovery, degraded/DLQ/replay, restart readback, and no promotion route opening.
tasks.rollout: Deploy admit-only behavior before enabling the worker; observe proposed backlog and process in bounded batches.
tasks.rollback: Pause worker processing while retaining proposed candidates; never restore inline processing or seed fallback.

tasks.title: Deliver the create-to-draft Workshop user journey
tasks.owner_capability: React, TypeScript, accessibility, and BFF integration
out_of_scope: Persona daily interaction outside Agora Workshop
acceptance: A new user can create a Workshop, post messages through Workshop commands, and see accepted/processing/succeeded/degraded receipt states without direct API seeding.

Use one canonical WorkshopCardRenderer for reconstruction, completeness, NBQ, draft/version, Research, Consultation, and conclusion cards; remove Persona daily interaction as the core composer target.
Expose governed card actions only when server capabilities permit and refresh canonical state after every write; local toast/state is never terminal success.
Reconnect and Last-Event-ID replay preserve ordered cards and do not expose foreign-user cache entries.
Implement desktop/mobile/accessibility coverage and keep writes hidden or disabled until the matching backend capability is live.
tasks.rollout: Merge to execute-plans dev behind backend capability/readiness gates; safe read-only behavior remains available.
tasks.rollback: Disable create/write controls and retain canonical read-only Workshop history.

tasks.title: Replace local candidate actions with one canonical review flow
tasks.owner_capability: React state and governed BFF action integration
acceptance: One reusable drawer implements review, park, research, shadow, select, reject, and discussion through canonical commands with receipts and readback.
The component takes a real candidate_pool_id/candidate_id and never treats a lens ID as a pool ID.
Pending, conflict, forbidden, degraded, empty, and replayed states are explicit; successful local state without server readback is impossible.
No hard-coded candidate reason, concerns, evidence, metrics, or next event is merged into live rows.
Reload tests prove durable member state and tenant-aware query/cache keys.
tasks.rollout: Ship the component unused or capability-gated until Trading Room assembly binds the authoritative pool lookup.
tasks.rollback: Retain read-only candidate display and disable actions; do not restore the page-local fake drawer.

tasks.title: Build honest workspace components and remove dead Agora UI islands
tasks.owner_capability: senior React architecture and dead-code consolidation
tasks.reviewer_capability: workspace contract, bundle, and UX review
acceptance: Use one ChartSpec/widget renderer and one revision component that consume typed WorkspaceIntent/proposal/data contracts and display source status/as_of/cutoff/lineage.
Remove live keyword/regex servant simulation, client-authored proposedSpec authority, Mock Mode success, local-only usefulness/evidence actions, and sample widget data.
Migrate unique tests/validation before deleting the obsolete AgoraApp M0 shell, dashboard island, old WidgetRenderer, and old WidgetRevisionDrawer.
Unavailable widgets are hidden or explicitly unavailable in live mode; no absent data is presented as a functional dashboard.
Import graph and production bundle tests prove the obsolete islands and fixtures are gone.
tasks.rollout: Merge reusable components and cleanup without changing active TradingRoomPage until the assembly task.
tasks.rollback: Restore only canonical read-only components if necessary; never restore mock success or duplicate production islands.

tasks.title: Use only owner-scoped Agora performance truth in the UI
tasks.owner_capability: React data-state and governed action integration
acceptance: All Strategy Performance panels consume Agora-scoped StrategyPerformanceIndex and suggestion endpoints; direct Management attribution calls are removed.
Observed, simulated, shadow, stale, empty, degraded, and unavailable states remain visually and semantically distinct.
Apply/reject/defer actions display durable receipt state and reload canonical suggestion status; no local toast is terminal success.
Source as-of/cutoff/lineage and action provenance are accessible without exposing another user's data.
Component and browser tests cover no-suggestion, producer-lag, conflict, forbidden, and restart/reload behavior.
tasks.rollout: Merge behind Agora performance capability detection; retain explicit unavailable state until backend index is live.
tasks.rollback: Return to Agora-scoped read-only state and disable actions; never reconnect the unscoped Management projection.

tasks.title: Integrate and verify the corrected Agora backend journey
tasks.reviewer_capability: tenant, receipt, lineage, and verifier integrity review
out_of_scope: repairing component product code from verifier failures
acceptance: Build a non-repairing service-bound verifier for Workshop hypothesis through reconstruction, Registry draft, Research, real/empty candidate truth, Trading workspace, decision intent, Performance, DatasetVersion, policy candidate, independent Consultation, and sponsor decision.

Correlate exact tenant/user, strategy, Registry, Workshop, run/artifact, pool, workspace/version, decision/intent, performance, dataset, candidate, ConsultRequest/memo, receipt, event, and trace identities.
Validate command replay/CAS, two-user/two-tenant isolation, worker crash/recovery, DLQ/replay, service restart readback, and no broker/order/runtime-policy promotion.

Publish additive authoritative contract/OpenAPI/capability deltas and fail if any component retains client-derived truth, production fixture fallback, inline async processing, or auto-approved Consultation.
Verifier returns nonzero for missing service, missing producer, seeded-only truth, stale/unscoped data, mismatched lineage, missing ACK, self-attested memo, or absent canonical readback.
tasks.rollout: Verifier and additive contracts only; failures return to the owning task rather than creating implementation here.
tasks.rollback: Revert verifier/contracts if necessary; do not mutate product/runtime as rollback.

tasks.title: Assemble the complete Agora frontend on canonical contracts
tasks.owner_capability: cross-page frontend integration and browser E2E
tasks.reviewer_capability: product journey, contract, and accessibility review
acceptance: Assemble one Trading Room page using authoritative strategy-to-pool lookup, canonical candidate drawer, typed WorkspaceIntent/compiler proposal, live widget data states, decision-event commands, and durable readback.
Remove fixed lens IDs, page-local candidate drawer/state transitions, sample candidates/metrics, client readiness/freshness, and all remaining local-only success paths.
Wire TradingDeskLayout jobs/shadow/journal controls to real panels/routes or remove disabled controls; no button may only toggle invisible local state.
Regenerate TypeScript from the accepted backend contract and pass exact capability/schema hash binding with no direct non-BFF API calls.
Authenticated desktop/mobile Playwright completes create Workshop through governed intent and owner-scoped Performance, including empty/degraded/error and cross-user cache isolation.
validation: typecheck and full Agora focused tests
tasks.rollout: Merge to execute-plans dev after backend contracts are additive and accepted; deployment remains a separate task.
tasks.rollback: Revert to the last accepted read-only frontend commit; do not restore Lovable, fixtures, or local-only actions.

tasks.title: Deploy and accept the corrected Agora exact pair
tasks.owner_capability: cross-repo release and hosted exact-pair acceptance
tasks.reviewer_capability: independent deployment, security, and evidence audit
acceptance: Use gate-before-switch and rollback-safe Pantheon-owned dev delivery; served FE/BFF identities, manifest, compatibility hashes, reviewed source commits, and deployed symlinks must match exactly.
Require /readyz healthy with active worker/controller state and cursor agreement; manifest/runtime SHA drift, repair_only workers, stale watermarks, or failed candidate checks reject the switch.

Run the real backend verifier plus authenticated desktop/mobile frontend journey, two-user/two-tenant negatives, BFF/worker restart, and durable receipt/artifact/dataset/candidate/memo readback on the same pair.
Prove live BFF mode, strict fallback, safe write defaults, no embedded token, no fixture fallback, no order/capital authority, and explicit governed dev-write windows where required.
Publish an independently reviewed gap-by-gap evidence matrix; on any failure keep or restore the last accepted exact pair and leave the candidate unaccepted.
tasks.rollout: One bounded dev exact-pair candidate through the existing deployment workflow after both integration tasks merge.
tasks.rollback: Reselect the last accepted exact pair and safe read-only profile; never edit a manifest to match a drifted runtime.
